object.description: Steps: Run LiveSessionMetricsTest. Expected: Distance comes from smoothed positions; a location fix worse than 20 m adds no distance but stays on the route; the first location fix after a resume adds 0 m and the totals stay; a climb during a pause adds no elevation gain; steps during a pause are not counted. Uses a stand-in distance function, so the WGS-84 calculation itself is covered by PACE-STS-35.
